title: Clinical Validation of the M5L Lung CAD
brief_summary: To compare the diagnostic performance and time efficiency of Computer-Aided Detection (CAD) assisted reading for the identification of pulmonary nodules in chest Computed Tomography (CT) from oncological patients with that of unassisted reading.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed extra-thoracic neoplasm

Exclusion Criteria:

* More than 10 nodules
* Severe pulmonary fibrosis
* Diffuse bronchiectasis
* Extensive inflammatory consolidation
* Massive pleural effusion
* Pregnancy
study_population: Between September 2015 and March 2016, 237 consecutive patients (123 men, 52%) with an average age of 62 (range 21-90 years), were enrolled in this retrospective observational single centre study. Patients enrolled into the study performed CT either for staging, restaging or follow-up of extrathoracic malignancies
